options.content:
**RPO** is measured continuously from the backup store (objective 1 h).

**RTO cannot be measured continuously.** It is demonstrated by drills. Observed in the [2026-11-21 game day](https://github.com/ManuJacks/kubernetes-in-finance/blob/main/docs/gameday/2026-11-21-api-availability.md): load-balancer crash failover **3.6 s**, HAProxy failure **5.3 s**, etcd leader loss **no full outage**. These are lab measurements, not guarantees.

| # | KPI | Target | How it is measured | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | etcd RPO | **≤ 1 h** | Age of newest snapshot, continuous | Live (pages at 90 min) |
| 2 | Backup success | **100 %** of attempts | Per-node outcome of every hourly run | Live (ticket on any failure) |
| 3 | Restore drill freshness | **≤ 7 d** since last success | Weekly isolated restore drill (timer) | Live (ticket at 8 d) |
| 4 | Control-plane failover RTO | **LB 30 s, control-plane node 60 s** | Game-day drills | Demonstrated 2026-11-21: 3.6 s / 5.3 s / no full outage |
| 5 | Workload recovery | **≤ 6 min** | Monthly node-loss drill (manual; see panels below) | Drill ready; first run pending |
| 6 | Control-plane node replacement | ≤ 30 min | Not yet drilled | **Defined, unmeasured** |
| 7 | Full cluster restore RTO | ≤ 2 h | Not yet drilled (isolated restore only) | **Defined, unmeasured** |
| 8 | API availability SLO | **99.9 %** over 30 d | `/readyz` through the VIP every 10 s | Live (burn-rate pages) |
| 9 | Mean time to detect | **≤ 5 min** for a full API outage | `promtool` rule test: fast burn fires by 5 min | Tested in CI; delivery verified to ntfy |

Lab objectives for this platform, not production commitments. Unmeasured KPIs are listed so they are not mistaken for achieved ones.
